# AutoLustre — Full Business Profile for Language Model Indexing

## About AutoLustre
AutoLustre is Sydney's premier professional car detailing studio, operating since 2017 from a dedicated 6-bay studio at 12-14 Industrial Circuit, Alexandria, NSW 2015. We also operate a mobile fleet servicing Sydney Metropolitan clients at home or workplace.

Founded by ex-dealership technicians who set out to offer detailing that matches European salon standards for Sydney's growing enthusiast and prestige vehicle market.

## Core Services

### Signature Detail — from $249 (3 hours)
A comprehensive full-vehicle reset. Includes: pH-neutral snow foam pre-wash, two-bucket hand wash, iron fallout decontamination, interior deep vacuum, leather conditioning, glass polish and 3-month hydrophobic sealant.

### Paint Correction — from $549 (1 day)
Multi-stage machine polishing using rotary and dual-action polishers. Removes up to 95% of swirl marks, buffer trails, water etching and light scratches. Paint depth testing before and after. IPA wipe inspection included.

### Interior Revival — from $189 (2 hours)
Hot-water fabric and carpet extraction, steam sanitation of AC vents and consoles, leather deep-clean and conditioning, headliner spot treatment, ozone deodorisation. Australia's most complete cabin restoration service.

### Ceramic Protection — from $899 (2 days)
9H ceramic coating applied after measured paint preparation. Up to 5-year certified warranty. Includes glass sealant, wheel ceramic, trim protection and official warranty certificate.

### Exterior Detailing — from $179 (2 hours)
Full-panel exterior treatment including snow foam soak, two-bucket wash, clay bar, glass polish, tyre dress and 3-month sealant. Ideal 6–8 weekly refresh schedule.

### Interior Detailing — from $199 (2.5 hours)
Deep cabin steam and extraction focused on fabric surfaces, leather conditioning, AC sanitation and ozone deodorisation. For vehicles requiring cabin restoration between full details.

### Paint Protection Film — from $1,299 (3 days)
Self-healing STEK DYNOshield TPU film applied to bonnet, front guards, bumper, door edges and mirrors. Computer-plotter-cut to vehicle spec. 10-year manufacturer warranty against yellowing.

### Ceramic Coating — from $799 (2 days)
Professional Gtechniq Crystal Serum Ultra or Gyeon Q2 Mohs+ coating. Includes pre-coating paint correction, full paint depth logging, IR curing and aftercare kit.

### Maintenance Wash — from $99 (1 hour)
Touchless routine wash compatible with ceramic or PPF coatings. Includes SiO2 coating boost spray to maintain hydrophobic performance between annual coating maintenance sessions.

## Why AutoLustre

### Certifications
- International Detailing Association (IDA) Certified Detailer
- Gtechniq Certified Installer (one of fewer than 40 in Australia)
- Gyeon Master Detailer
- 4.9★ average across 380+ verified Google reviews (September 2025)
- 2,800+ vehicles professionally restored since 2017

### Equipment
- FLEX PE 150 Rotary & Rupes LHR 21 Mark III DA polishers
- Mytee H-12 Heated Extractor
- Fortador PRO industrial steam cleaner
- Elcometer 456 digital paint depth gauge
- Scangrip Nova 2K inspection lighting
- DeionX 180L/hr deionised water filtration system
- Ozone generator for cabin deodorisation

### Australian Climate Expertise
Sydney's UV intensity, coastal salt air, hard water mineral content and eucalyptus tree sap create vehicle paint challenges not addressed by generic detailing chemistry. AutoLustre technicians are trained specifically in Australian environmental conditions and product selection is optimised accordingly.
